# Demo run — Part 1 of the four-part standard (generated by `python run_w12.py demo`)

## 1. A v2.4 caller asks how to paginate (version resolved first, v2 page cited by version, deprecations surfaced unasked)

> **Question:** How do I paginate through my messages?  
> **IDE sent:** `sdk_version=2.4` · **resolved before retrieval:** `2.4` via `request_metadata` · **trace id:** `t_f61bd75b30` · **laps:** 4 · **cost:** $0.00439

**Answering for Acme SDK 2.4** (version taken from your IDE's request metadata).

`Client.list_messages()` returns one page of your stored messages at a time.

Here is a sample for Acme SDK 2.4:

```python
from acme_sdk import Client, AuthConfig

client = Client(auth=AuthConfig(token="sk_live_example"))
page = 1
while True:
    result = client.list_messages(page=page, per_page=50)
    for item in result.items:
        print(item)
    if page >= result.total_pages:
        break
    page += 1
```

**Heads-up for your upgrade:** `Client.list_messages(per_page=...)` (deprecated from 2.6) is removed in 3.0. Use `Client.list_messages(limit=...)` instead (available since 2.6; you are on 2.4, so upgrade to 2.6 first).

**Heads-up for your upgrade:** `ListResult.total_pages` is removed in 3.0.

**Heads-up for your upgrade:** `AuthConfig(token=...)` (deprecated from 2.5) is removed in 3.0. Use `AuthConfig(api_key=...)` instead (available since 2.5; you are on 2.4, so upgrade to 2.5 first).

**Sources:**
- [Pagination (Acme SDK 2.x) - reference, Acme SDK 2.x](https://docs.acme-sdk.example/2.x/pagination#pagination-acme-sdk-2-x)
- [Page through messages by page number (2.0 to 2.4) - sample, Acme SDK 2.x](https://docs.acme-sdk.example/2.x/samples/paginate_2_0.py)

## 2. Same caller, plain question: a deprecation nobody asked about

> **Question:** How do I send a message?  
> **IDE sent:** `sdk_version=2.4` · **resolved before retrieval:** `2.4` via `request_metadata` · **trace id:** `t_4d94880fed` · **laps:** 4 · **cost:** $0.00410

**Answering for Acme SDK 2.4** (version taken from your IDE's request metadata).

`Client.send()` sends a single message to the Acme API and waits for a response. Use it for simple, non-streaming calls where you want the full reply before continuing. It replaces `Client.sendMessage()` (added in 2.2).

Here is a sample for Acme SDK 2.4:

```python
from acme_sdk import Client, AuthConfig

client = Client(auth=AuthConfig(token="sk_live_example"))
response = client.send(message="hello", timeout_ms=5000)
print(response.body)
```

**Deprecation notice:** `Client.sendMessage` has been deprecated since 2.4 and will be removed in 3.0. Use `Client.send` instead (available since 2.2; you can switch now).

**Heads-up for your upgrade:** `AuthConfig(token=...)` (deprecated from 2.5) is removed in 3.0. Use `AuthConfig(api_key=...)` instead (available since 2.5; you are on 2.4, so upgrade to 2.5 first).

**Sources:**
- [Client.send() - reference, Acme SDK 2.x](https://docs.acme-sdk.example/2.x/client#client-send)
- [Send a message (2.2 to 2.4) - sample, Acme SDK 2.x](https://docs.acme-sdk.example/2.x/samples/send_2_2.py)

## 3. "That method no longer exists in 3.0 - here is the migration"

> **Question:** Does client.pollStream still work in 3.0?  
> **IDE sent:** `sdk_version=2.4` · **resolved before retrieval:** `2.4` via `request_metadata` · **trace id:** `t_591be8fb9f` · **laps:** 6 · **cost:** $0.00651

**Answering for Acme SDK 2.4** (version taken from your IDE's request metadata).

`Client.pollStream` **no longer exists in 3.0** - it was deprecated in 2.4 and removed in 3.0. Migration: use `Client.stream`, which has existed since 2.4, so you can switch before you upgrade.

On your version (2.4) it still works, but it is deprecated.

`Client.pollStream()` no longer exists in 3.0. The manual poll-in-a-loop pattern is replaced by `Client.stream()`, an iterator you can `for` over.

Here is a sample for Acme SDK 2.4:

```python
from acme_sdk import Client, AuthConfig

client = Client(auth=AuthConfig(token="sk_live_example"))
for chunk in client.stream(message="hello"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

**Deprecation notice:** `Client.pollStream` - the previous name of `Client.stream` - has been deprecated since 2.4 and will be removed in 3.0. If your code or an old tutorial still uses it, switch to `Client.stream`.

**Heads-up for your upgrade:** `AuthConfig(token=...)` (deprecated from 2.5) is removed in 3.0. Use `AuthConfig(api_key=...)` instead (available since 2.5; you are on 2.4, so upgrade to 2.5 first).

**Sources:**
- [Streaming a reply - migration guide, Acme SDK 3.0](https://docs.acme-sdk.example/3.0/migration#streaming-a-reply)
- [2.4.0 - changelog, Acme SDK 2.x](https://docs.acme-sdk.example/2.x/changelog#2-4-0)
- [Stream a reply (2.4) - sample, Acme SDK 2.x](https://docs.acme-sdk.example/2.x/samples/stream_2_4.py)
